venonat-bug-buzz.name: Bug Buzz
venonat-bug-buzz.description: Bond skill: a damaging buzz from its wings at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 90).

venonat-u-turn.name: U-turn
venonat-u-turn.description: Bond skill: strikes and darts back (Power 60, Attack), ending its engagement.

venonat-quiver-dance.name: Quiver Dance
venonat-quiver-dance.description: Bond skill: a mystic dance makes it Fortified for 1 turn and Hasted for 2.

venonat-compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
venonat-compound-eyes.description: Its keen eyes find far targets: deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

venonat-run-away.name: Run Away
venonat-run-away.description: Flees from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

venonat-signal-beam.name: Signal Beam
venonat-signal-beam.description: New skill: a sinister beam at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 55) that Slows it for 1 turn.

venonat-venom-feeder.name: Venom Feeder
venonat-venom-feeder.description: Deals 20% more damage to Poisoned foes.

venonat-powdery-wings.name: Powdery Wings
venonat-powdery-wings.description: Its scales blur its shape: takes 10% less damage.

venonat-venoshock.name: Venoshock
venonat-venoshock.description: New skill: drenches a foe up to 2 hexes away in a toxic liquid (Power 65).

venonat-bug-bite.name: Bug Bite
venonat-bug-bite.description: New skill: a quick, sharp bite (Power 60).

venonat-shield-dust.name: Shield Dust
venonat-shield-dust.description: Its dust wards it: immune to Poison, Burn and Paralysis.

venonat-tinted-lens.name: Tinted Lens
venonat-tinted-lens.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

venonat-poison-fang.name: Poison Fang
venonat-poison-fang.description: New skill: sinks venomous fangs into a foe (Power 80), Poisoning it for 2 turns.

venonat-silver-wind.name: Silver Wind
venonat-silver-wind.description: New skill: a gust of scale dust at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80).

venonat-scale-shed.name: Scale Shed
venonat-scale-shed.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

venonat-eye-for-weakness.name: Eye for Weakness
venonat-eye-for-weakness.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes with any status.

venonat-sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
venonat-sludge-bomb.description: New skill: lobs sludge up to 2 hexes away (Power 90), Poisoning the foe for 2 turns.

venonat-pollen-puff.name: Pollen Puff
venonat-pollen-puff.description: New skill: a bursting ball of pollen at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85).

venonat-potent-powders.name: Potent Powders
venonat-potent-powders.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

venonat-swift-wings.name: Swift Wings
venonat-swift-wings.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

venonat-moth-of-dusk.name: Moth of Dusk
venonat-moth-of-dusk.description: Capstone. Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon; its non-damaging skills recharge 1 turn faster.

venonat-plague-moth.name: Plague Moth
venonat-plague-moth.description: Capstone. When a foe it afflicted faints, adjacent foes catch that status; +1 Bond per knockout.

venonat-disable.name: Disable
venonat-disable.description: New skill: its eyes seal a foe's skills up to 2 hexes away for 1 turn (Disabled).
